scientific_integrity: The exact Hasse-recursion and local valuations establish the claim; computational checks use exact GF(7)[x,t] polynomial arithmetic. No independent validation or peer review is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Algebraically closed characteristic-seven fields; only the marked pencil with t^2 different from 4. Higher-Hasse-Wronskian weights use the exceptional order sequence (0,1,2,3,4,7), not the classical characteristic-zero sequence. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: The exceptional characteristic-seven bicanonical Wronskian of a genus-three hyperelliptic pencil
